description: Before money moves: every eligible route for a payment scored against your own limits (maximum LDI, maximum settlement time, regulated provider required), your quote measured if you pass one, beside what banks advertise, the official business-payment average and the G20 lines. Evidence against your policy, never a recommendation. Returns a signed decision record: keep it with the payment and pass it to swapeazi_guardrail_reconcile once it settles. Paid: configure this server with an Authorization Bearer key (https://swapeazi.io/pricing).

allowed_providers.description: Optional. Restrict routes to your own already-connected panel, by provider label or id. For embedding this assessment as a mandatory step inside your own already-licensed release pipeline. asking which of YOUR connected providers should carry this, not who exists in the market, the way an execution-management system asks which of its own connected brokers should fill an order. A provider outside the panel is ruled out before scoring, never silently dropped: it appears in ruled_out with reason not_in_callers_connected_panel. Omit for no restriction.

client_id.description: Optional. Your own reference, echoed back.

destination_jurisdiction.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the beneficiary.

max_acceptable_ldi_bps.description: Optional. Your cost cap in basis points.

origin_jurisdiction.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the sender.

quote.description: Optional. A quote you already hold, to be measured as given.

landed_amount.description: Amount the quote says will land, in the destination currency.

provider.description: Who gave the quote, e.g. a bank or provider name; for the record, not used to price.

source_amount.description: Amount to send, in the origin currency.

name: swapeazi_guardrail_check
title: Pre-trade guardrail assess
